title: A study to learn about the effects and safety of LIB-01 in healthy adults and participants with erectile dysfunction
official: A phase 2b, randomized, double-blind, parallel, and placebo-controlled trial investigating efficacy and safety of LIB-01 in erectile dysfunction including an initial safety cohort in healthy adult participants
summary:
Main objective: Part 1: To evaluate the safety and tolerability of repeated administrations of LIB-01 oral tablets up to 100 mg daily doses in healthy participants

Part 2: To evaluate the efficacy of repeated administrations of LIB-01 oral tablets in the treatment of ED for all active treatment groups pooled vs. placebo

interventions.name: White to off-white solid tablet identical to the active LIB-01 25 mg tablet

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Healthy men will take part in Part 1 if they are aged between 18 and 65 years, weigh at least 50 kgs, are non-smokers within 3 months before joining this part, and are willing to use condoms from the start of treatment to 2 days after treatment or not engage in unprotected sex.  Men with ED will take part in Part 2 if they are aged between 25 and 70 years, have a stable heterosexual relationship for at least 6 months, are willing to be sexually active at least once a week and use condoms from the start of treatment to 2 days after treatment or not engage in unprotected sex, and have a score below a certain level on a questionnaire that measures erectile functioning of men.  For the full list of the inclusion criteria please refer to Protocol section 4.2.
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants will be assessed to see if they have any conditions which might exclude them from participating, could interfere with the trial, or pose an unacceptable risk.  Participants to whom any of the following applies will be excluded from the study:  1.	Part 1: Multiple Dose Safety Cohort in Healthy Participants Exclusion Criteria 2.	Part 2: Phase 2b Efficacy Study Exclusion Criteria  For the full list of the exclusion criteria please refer to Protocol section 4.3.
